name: 115.简

basedOn.note: User explicitly reported Test16 as normal. Test17 therefore continues from the account/capacity/settings baseline and changes only file-management UX.

features: add a compact 常用 entry in File Management instead of putting recent/favorite folders directly into the main list
automatically remember up to 12 recently opened folders without extra network requests
allow long-pressing a folder to add/remove it from 收藏目录
add a dedicated 常用目录 page with 收藏目录 and 最近访问 plus root and clear-recent controls
reuse stored breadcrumb trail so shortcuts reopen the real directory with normal Root/Up navigation
keep existing name/time/size sorting and type-filter state persistence
use lightweight resource-type icons for video/image/audio/document/archive/other rows while keeping the existing click and long-press management contracts
shorten a few prompts and labels to reduce information density
validationTarget: entering folders records recent directories and 常用 page can reopen them
long-press folder 收藏目录 / 取消收藏 works
clearing recent access does not delete files or favorite folders
Root/Up breadcrumb navigation remains correct after opening from shortcuts
sort/filter, new folder, batch operations, rename/copy/move/delete remain unchanged
search, account center, offline center, recycle bin and external magnet flow do not regress
